summary: Klondike patience with one deck. Seven piles of cards, the lower cards face down; a stock of face-down cards, a waste beside it and four foundations. Face-up cards are moved between piles on to a card one rank higher of the other colour, a king on to an empty pile, and to the foundations by suit from the ace up. Turning the stock puts its next card face up on the waste. The game is won when every card is on the foundations.

cells.looks: a face-up card: its rank and suit, written as rank then suit letter (AS, 10H, JD, KC; suits S spades, H hearts, D diamonds, C clubs)
a place for cards that holds none (an outline, a faint symbol)

state_fields.stock: 1 while the stock holds face-down cards, 0 when it is empty (an outline or a turn-over symbol), null when it cannot be told
state_fields.waste: the card on top of the waste (the face-up cards beside the stock; the top one is the one fully in view), "0" when the waste is empty, null when it cannot be read
state_fields.foundations: four entries from the left: the top card of each foundation, "0" for an empty one, null for one that cannot be read
state_fields.tableau: seven entries from the left, one per pile: {"down": how many cards lie face down in it, "up": its face-up cards from the deepest one to the top one}; a pile with no cards is {"down": 0, "up": []}; null for a card or count that cannot be read
state_fields.scene: the id of the scene the screen shows

actions.description: put the waste back as the stock when the stock is empty: tap the stock's place
drag from `from` (["waste"], or ["tableau", pile, how many of its top cards]) to `to` (["tableau", pile] or ["foundation", index])

scenes.looks: the game's own message that it is won
the game's own message that no move is left

draw.description: how many cards one turn of the stock moves to the waste (only the simulated game deals by it)

places.stock: the stock, or the place it leaves when empty
places.waste: the top card of the waste, or its empty place
places.foundation: a list of four: each foundation's top card, or its empty place
places.tableau: a list of seven: for each pile the list of the boxes of its face-up cards, deepest first, each box the part of the card that is in view; for a pile with no face-up card a list of one box, its empty place
